subject: Full proposed grabber retrofit, a view
status: Technical concept illustration; not dimensioned or mechanically validated
neck_geometry: The stock silver neck is a rectangular prism with a square cross-section, flat faces, and sharp longitudinal edges; every shaft clamp must fit the square profile, not a cylinder.
color_key: Only the stock center brace and stock handle are blue. All added 3D-printed retrofit parts are orange. Stock metal remains silver; original claw feet and squeeze trigger remain black.

axes.y: up, parallel to the long reacher neck
axes.z: out of the page toward the viewer; negative z goes into the page

requirements: One complete reacher and its attachments in one view; no inset or additional view.
Preserve the exact reference grabber's silver fluted shaft, curved claws, black claw feet, blue pistol handle, and moving black squeeze trigger.
Keep the stock V-claw span and the single blue center brace at the same relative shaft position as stock reference 0a; retrofit parts do not change them.
Keep the phone below the claw fork and outside the moving claw sweep, held in a removable GoPro-like corner harness on a split neck clamp.
The phone lies in a plane perpendicular to the neck, with uncovered rear cameras facing up the neck toward the claws.
Rotate the phone about the neck's y-axis until its short bottom edge and charging port face the viewer; its long side recedes into depth.

Translate the phone toward positive x and negative z until its near thin long side face, perpendicular to the broad camera face, rests against the neck-mounted support. Keep the charging-port edge visible and the camera face pointed toward the claws.
Route one external bicycle brake Bowden cable from the phone lever down the shaft to a stationary housing anchor and a visible removable tab on the moving black handle trigger, consistent with 3a.
The cable-driven lever contacts a side volume rocker; it does not press the charging port.
Show a small x/y/z axis glyph on opaque white paper, with positive z represented as coming out of the page, in a technical engineering drawing style.

subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.neck: Measured rectangular section: 14 mm project X, 19 mm project Z. Supersedes square assumption; original image preserved.
subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.carrier: One adjustable opposing padded-jaw carrier for bare/cased phones, including 18 mm wallet case; no GoPro interface.
subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.actuation: Adjustable volume-up contact held during squeeze; spring accommodation for excess travel; compact 3a housing anchor and flexible trigger strap.
subsequent_measured_cad_constraints.status: Historical illustration unchanged; consult source/ and print/ for R3 CAD geometry.

r4_review_constraints.cable: centered on trigger-facing shaft face; upper moving-trigger Velcro tie
